[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-fb[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Stop silently losing agent bead closes written in ephemeral [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]workspaces[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A `sase bead close` run by an agent inside a numbered workspace [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]either reaches the canonical bead store or fails loudly. The CLI [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never prints `✓ Closed` for a mutation that exists only in a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workspace-local sidecar clone, workspace eviction can never destroy[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]unpublished canonical bead commits, and the post-completion [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]finalizer verifies published state instead of the local projection.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make every bead-store mutation publication-verified before the[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]CLI reports success[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]publish[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]publish: after a bead mutation commits, verify the commit actually [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reached the canonical remote; force a synchronous publish when it did [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]not, and fail the command loudly when it still cannot publish, instead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of returning 0 on a workspace-local-only write.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Refuse to evict a workspace sidecar clone that holds [/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]unpublished bead commits[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]evict[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]evict: teach the launch-time workspace bead safety net about the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sidecar-repos layout and wire it into the eviction path so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`clear_workspace_repos` can never trash a `sase--beads` clone with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unpushed canonical bead commits.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify published bead state in the post-completion finalizer[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]finalize[dim] · [dim][/dim]after publish[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]finalize: make the finalizer's bead safety net publish and verify rather[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]than only commit, and stop instructing agents to confirm a close with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]command that reads the local projection.[/#D7D7AF]
